page_title: PSG 3-1 LIL | PSG v Lille 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' A pass lands at the feet of Remy Cabella (Lille) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
90+3' Total attempts – 16:9.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' A quickly taken corner by Lille.
86' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' The goalkeeper dives to deny Bradley Barcola (PSG), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
84' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:7.
81' That's the end of the game for Yusuf Yazici, who is replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
80' 3 - 1 Goal! Bradley Barcola passes the ball to the feet of Randal Kolo Muani (PSG), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:1.
80' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Marco Asensio (PSG) takes it short.
79' One of the players from Lille times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
76' Lucas Chevalier (Lille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
75' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Nordi Mukiele (PSG) for his blatant foul.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) will replace Goncalo Ramos.

74' A tremendous drive by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Lucas Chevalier makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
72' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
69' It is time for a substitution. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is on for Lucas Hernandez.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonathan David (Lille) replaces Benjamin Andre.
67' Here is a change. Gabriel Gudmundsson is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Remy Cabella (Lille).
67' Here comes a substitution. Adam Ounas (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Edon Zhegrova.
65' The shots on goal statistics – 5:2.
62' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Fabian Ruiz will be replaced by Vitinha (PSG).
62' Substitution. Ousmane Dembele leaves the pitch and is replaced by Bradley Barcola (PSG).
59' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

59' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
57' Nordi Mukiele (PSG) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
56' Marco Asensio (PSG) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' The possession of the ball – 53:47.
53' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Alexsandro (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
51' PSG string together a series of short passes.
50' Marco Asensio (PSG) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
48' Angel Gomes (Lille) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
47' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from PSG was in an offside position.
46' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Tiago Santos (Lille) was too forceful with his tackle and Francois Letexier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45+3' PSG hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Corner kicks – 1:2.
40' Paulo Fonseca isn't happy on the touchline after referee Francois Letexier shows him a yellow card.
39' Tiago Santos (Lille) brings his opponent down. Francois Letexier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

37' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
32' Ismaily (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
31' Lille fail to score from a corner as Keylor Navas (PSG) leaps to collect the ball.
29' 4:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
27' Francois Letexier blows his whistle after Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
25' Benjamin Andre (Lille) picks up an injury.
21' Marco Asensio (PSG) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
17' 2 - 1 Alexsandro (Lille) deflects the ball past his own goalkeeper and into the goal after trying to jump in the way of a shot!
17' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Lucas Chevalier.
16' Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
15' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
15' Ball possession – 46:54.
12' Lille are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
10' 1 - 1 Goncalo Ramos (PSG) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
9' A player from Lille brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
6' 0 - 1 Goal! Yusuf Yazici (Lille) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:1.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from PSG. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lille will have the kick-off.
Francois Letexier was nominated as the referee for this game.
